notable_absence.finding: The page states 'The `_default` scope of the `travel_sample` bucket duplicates all of the data stored in the `inventory` and `tenant_agent_00` through `tenant_agent_04` scopes' for backward-compatibility reasons ('makes the bucket compatible with scripts and applications written for versions of Couchbase Server earlier than 7.0 that did not support scopes and collections'). No relation was minted for this: the registry has no predicate for 'these two scopes hold duplicate copies of the same data, maintained for backward-compatibility reasons', and forcing it into cascadesDeletionTo, isSynonymOf, or aliases would misrepresent the fact - none of those model two live, independently-addressable copies of the same rows kept in sync for compatibility. Omitted rather than mis-predicated, per the evidence-gate's own guidance.
